paper.title: AntiFold: Improved antibody structure-based design using inverse folding

result.summary: 本文提出了 AntiFold，一个从 ESM-IF1 微调而来的抗体特异性逆折叠模型，用于在保持抗体骨架结构的前提下设计序列 [S1.p6]。AntiFold 接受已解析或预测的抗体可变域结构，输出每个残基的突变容忍度（perplexity）和氨基酸概率，并可选地采样新序列 [S1.p6]。在 CDR 序列恢复上，AntiFold 优于现有逆折叠工具，设计的序列重新折叠后与原结构高度相似 [abstract]。在零样本预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力时，AntiFold 也取得了更强的相关性，加入抗原信息后性能进一步提升 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 抗体优化中的一个关键考虑是选择能维持结构、从而维持稳定性与抗原结合模式等结构介导性质的突变，而现有抗体逆折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复能力有限 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。此外，基于 ProteinMPNN 的工具存在抗体链重排、CDRH3 第 112 位插入或向 IMGT 编号抗体引入空位等问题，与抗体结构不兼容 [S1.p5]。因此，本文旨在开发一个抗体特异性逆折叠模型，以改进 CDR 序列恢复和零样本亲和力预测 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: A guiding consideration in antibody optimization is selecting mutations that maintain the structure and therefore structure-mediated properties, such as stability and antigen binding mode.
However, the sequence recovery of existing tools for the CDR regions has been limited.

Additionally, ProteinMPNN-based tools have features such as the occasional re-ordering of antibody chains or CDRH3 position 112 insertions, or the introduction of gaps into IMGT numbered antibodies, incompatible with antibody structures.
Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model fine-tuned from ESM-IF1, which significantly improves upon CDR sequence recovery and zero-shot affinity prediction.

method.text: AntiFold 是一个抗体特异性逆折叠模型，通过在抗体结构上微调 ESM-IF1 逆折叠架构训练得到 [S0.SS1.SSS3.p1]。逆折叠问题被形式化为在给定骨架原子空间坐标的结构 X 下，学习蛋白质序列 Y 的条件概率分布 p(Y|X) [S0.SS1.SSS3.p1]。用户输入抗体可变域 PDB 结构（重链和轻链）并指定要设计的 IMGT 区域，AntiFold 为每个残基位置输出结构突变容忍度、残基概率以及若干条设计序列（默认 10 条），序列多样性可通过温度参数控制 [S2.F1]。

evidence.quote: We trained AntiFold by fine-tuning the ESM-IF1 inverse folding architecture (Figure S1) on antibody structures.

The inverse folding problem can be formalized as learning the conditional probability distribution, $p(Y|X)$, of the protein sequence, $Y$, consisting of amino acids $(y_{1},\ldots,y_{i},\ldots,y_{n})$, given the structure, $X$, with spatial coordinates of the backbone atoms (N, C α and C) $(x_{1},\ldots,x_{i},\ldots,x_{3n})$ (Equation (1)).
The user inputs an antibody variable domain PDB structure (heavy and light chain) and specifies an IMGT region to design.

AntiFold outputs for each residue position in the PDB: i) structural tolerance to mutations without altering the backbone structure, ii) residue probabilities and iii) a number of designed sequences (default 10) for the selected region, predicted to maintain its structural fold.
The diversity of the generated sequences may be controlled with a temperature parameter.

experiments.text: 训练数据来自 AbMPNN 数据集，包含 2,074 个抗体-蛋白抗原复合物结构，经冗余过滤且实验分辨率小于 5 Å，并使用 SAbDab 的 IMGT 编号方案获取对应可变片段结构 [S0.SS1.SSS1.p1]。验证集和测试集结构用 ABodyBuilder2 建模，以评估 AntiFold 在预测结构上的性能 [S0.SS1.SSS1.p1]。在结合亲和力预测中，作者对 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2,209 个可变域变体进行深度突变扫描，计算逆折叠对数似然，并以基于序列的 ESM-2（650M 参数）作为基线 [S3.SS3.p1]。此外，作者还将模型应用于 7 个抗体、124 个变体，这些变体来自蛋白语言模型引导的亲和力成熟实验 [S3.SS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: The AbMPNN dataset contains 2,074 structures of antibodies in complex with a protein antigen, after filtering for redundancy and experimental resolution $<$ 5 Å.
We obtained structures of the corresponding variable fragment domains (Figure S1), numbered with the IMGT antibody numbering scheme from SAbDab.
We modeled structures of the validation and test set using ABodyBuilder2 to evaluate AntiFold performance on predicted structures.
We calculated the log-likelihoods of the 2209 variable domain variants of Fab D44.1 (PDB 1MLC) (Figure S6).
As a sequence-only baseline, we included the sequence-based ESM-2 model (650M parameters).
we applied the model to 124 variants across 7 antibodies generated in protein language model-guided affinity maturation experiments.

findings.text: AntiFold 在 CDR 序列恢复上优于现有逆折叠工具，设计的序列与已解析结构高度相似 [abstract]。在抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测中，AntiFold 的 Spearman 秩相关为 0.418，显著优于 ESM-IF1（0.334）、AbMPNN（0.322）、ProteinMPNN（0.301）和 ESM-2（0.264）[S3.SS3.p1]。加入抗原链信息后，AntiFold 在所有 CDR 区域性能提升，尤其是 CDR2（Sr 42.7% 至 47.3%，p < 0.005）和 CDR3（Sr 29.8% 至 32.0%，p < 0.005），而框架残基未提升 [S3.SS3.p2]。在 124 个变体上，AntiFold 对改善变体的分离中位秩评分为 80%（p < 0.005），高于 ProteinMPNN 的 73%、ESM-IF1 的 57% 和 AbMPNN 的 55% [S3.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: AntiFold outperforms existing inverse folding tools on sequence recovery across complementarity-determining regions, with designed sequences showing high structural similarity to their solved counterpart.

AntiFold significantly outperformed the other models with a Spearman’s rank correlation of 0.418, versus ESM-IF1 (0.334), AbMPNN (0.322), ProteinMPNN (0.301) and ESM-2 (0.264), assessed by Mann-Whitney one-tailed U tests.

With this additional context, AntiFold’s performance improves in the case of all CDR regions, in particular the CDR2 ( $S_{r}$ 42.7 to 47.3%, p $<$ 0.005) and CDR3 ( $S_{r}$ 29.8 to 32.0%, p $<$ 0.005), but not for framework residues.

AntiFold achieved significantly improved separation of these groups, scoring the improved variants with a median rank score of 80% (p $<$ 0.005) versus 73 % for ProteinMPNN, 57 % for ESM-IF1 and 55 % for AbMPNN.
